text: Namaste bhai, mera pichle mahine ka EMI ECS bounce ho gaya tha aur mujhe usko theek karwana hai. Mera purana account band ho gaya tha kyunki maine bank change kar liya tha, aur ab naya account set up kar liya hai toh ECS mandate update karna hai. Kripya mujhe kisi aise vyakti se connect kijiye jo mandate ki details update kar sake.
